patterns.name: Ronin Bridge Validator Compromise
patterns.code_signature: Bridge required 5-of-9 validators; 4 keys controlled by a single party + one phished key compromised the threshold.
patterns.recommended_fix: Increase threshold (≥7-of-9), enforce independent custody, and audit the operational footprint of each signer.

patterns.name: Ronin Bridge (Axie Infinity) — validator-key-compromise
patterns.code_signature: Attacker compromised 5 of 9 Ronin validator keys (4 controlled by Sky Mavis plus a never-revoked Axie DAO gas-free RPC whitelist signature) and authorized fraudulent withdrawals.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: decentralize-validators-and-revoke-stale-access. Restore invariant: No single party should control a quorum of bridge validator signatures; withdrawal approvals must require independent honest validators..

patterns.name: Poly Network Cross-Chain Manager
patterns.code_signature: Cross-chain manager function selector collided; attacker called a privileged setter through the public bridge entrypoint.
patterns.recommended_fix: Strictly check msg.sender against an allowlist; avoid selectors that overlap public entrypoints; audit calldata routing.

patterns.name: Poly Network — cross_chain_privileged_call
patterns.code_signature: EthCrossChainManager could call any contract it owned; via a sighash collision the attacker invoked putCurEpochConPubKeyBytes on EthCrossChainData to replace the keeper public keys and seize control.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: separate_privileges_block_privileged_targets. Restore invariant: Cross-chain relay execution must never be able to call privileged self-owned management/data contracts..

patterns.name: BNB Chain (BSC Token Hub Bridge) — forged-merkle-proof-verification-bug
patterns.code_signature: A flaw in the IAVL Merkle proof verification of the BSC Token Hub cross-chain precompile let the attacker forge a proof for a withdrawal that never occurred, minting 2M BNB.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: fix-proof-verification-library. Restore invariant: Cross-chain withdrawal proofs must be cryptographically verified so that no forged proof can authorize minting on the destination chain..

patterns.name: FTX (unauthorized on-chain drain) — private-key-compromise
patterns.code_signature: During FTX's collapse/bankruptcy filing, an unauthorized party with access to FTX wallet keys drained hot wallets across Ethereum and Solana; exact access method never publicly confirmed.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: key-custody-and-access-control. Restore invariant: Only authorized custodians should be able to sign withdrawals from exchange hot wallets..

patterns.name: Wormhole Signature Verification
patterns.code_signature: Bridge core used a deprecated signature-verification function that returned true on default inputs.
patterns.recommended_fix: Pin to a non-deprecated signature primitive; assert non-zero recovered address; fuzz the verifier.

patterns.name: Wormhole Bridge — signature-verification-bypass
patterns.code_signature: Wormhole's Solana contract used a deprecated load_instruction_at that did not verify the sysvar instructions account, letting the attacker spoof the guardian SignatureSet and mint 120k whETH unbacked.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: use-verified-sysvar-and-upgrade-dependency. Restore invariant: whETH minted on Solana must be backed 1:1 by ETH locked in the Ethereum contract and authorized by a valid 2/3 guardian signature set..

patterns.name: DMM Bitcoin — Key Compromise
patterns.code_signature: Unauthorized access to highly privileged custodial private keys enabled mass UTXO transfers.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: Institutional Cold Storage and HSM-backed Signing. Restore invariant: Custodial cold/hot wallet boundaries must strictly prevent unauthorized mass UTXO transfers..

patterns.name: Kelp DAO — bridge message verification bypass
patterns.code_signature: KelpDAO used 1-of-1 DVN configuration for LayerZero OFT bridge; attacker forged cross-chain message by targeting off-chain verifier infrastructure (compromised or forced via DDoS/RPC), bypassing multi-verifier security to mint/unlock unbacked rsETH.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: mandatory multi-DVN diversity; on-chain message validation redundancy; monitoring of verifier health and config. Restore invariant: Cross-chain messages for bridge/OFT must be verified by diverse, independent DVNs; no single verifier or off-chain component may unilaterally authorize mint/unlock of tokens..

patterns.name: KelpDAO LayerZero DVN Drain
patterns.code_signature: LayerZero endpoint configured with a 1-of-N DVN verifier set; single operator key compromise enabled forged inbound messages.
patterns.recommended_fix: Require N≥3 distinct DVN operators with independent infrastructure and audited operational separation.

patterns.name: PlayDapp — Access Control
patterns.code_signature: Attacker added own address to authorized minter list via weak access control, enabling unauthorized minting of 1.79B PLA tokens.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: OpenZeppelin AccessControl and Timelocks. Restore invariant: Administrative roles such as minter must only be appended via heavily secured multi-signature governance with a timelock..

patterns.name: Drift Protocol — Signer Compromise via Social Engineering
patterns.code_signature: Months-long social engineering induced 2-of-5 Security Council signers to pre-sign durable-nonce transactions; zero-timelock governance permitted instant admin takeover; fake CVT collateral at manipulated oracle price then drained real assets.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: Mandatory Timelocks on Governance + Signer Environment Isolation (EDR) + Durable Nonce Restriction for Privileged Paths + Independent Signer Device Payload Decoding. Restore invariant: Governance/admin actions must require fresh, timelocked multisig approvals; no indefinitely-valid pre-signed authorizations should be possible on critical paths..

patterns.name: Drift Protocol — signer compromise
patterns.code_signature: DPRK-linked actors used 6-month social engineering campaign to obtain pre-signed transactions from Security Council members via durable nonces, then introduced fake collateral token with manipulated oracle price to drain vaults.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: hardware signing with policy enforcement; no durable nonce for high-privilege actions; oracle circuit breakers and collateral listing timelocks; multi-party computation or stricter council processes. Restore invariant: Only assets with genuine, manipulation-resistant oracles and verified collateral status may be used for borrowing or withdrawal; admin and signer actions must not be bypassable via social engineering or pre-signed nonce abuse..

patterns.name: WazirX — Signer Compromise
patterns.code_signature: Compromise of a multisig threshold allowed unauthorized withdrawal of exchange reserves via valid signatures.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: Geographic and Hardware Isolation of Signers. Restore invariant: Multisig threshold signatures must strictly require non-compromised, independent signers..

patterns.name: Euler Finance Donation Attack
patterns.code_signature: ERC4626-style vault with direct ERC20 transfer affecting share-price math; missing virtual-share offset.
patterns.recommended_fix: Inherit OpenZeppelin ERC4626 v4.7+ with _decimalsOffset, or mint a dead-share floor in the constructor.

patterns.name: Nomad Bridge Replay
patterns.code_signature: initialize() sets a sentinel value treated as 'already trusted' for any subsequent caller.
patterns.recommended_fix: Use OpenZeppelin `initializer` modifier; never trust sentinel/zero values; validate the trusted-root commit explicitly.

patterns.name: Nomad Bridge — improper-initialization-trusted-root
patterns.code_signature: A June Replica upgrade initialized the trusted root to 0x00, so any message (which hashes against 0x00 as the default) was treated as proven, letting anyone call process() to drain the bridge.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: safe-initialization-and-root-validation. Restore invariant: A cross-chain message must only execute if its root was genuinely proven; the zero/default root must never be trusted..

patterns.name: Beanstalk Governance Flashloan
patterns.code_signature: Governance executed proposals after a same-block flashloaned stake-weighted vote.
patterns.recommended_fix: Require voting delay (snapshot of stake at proposal creation, not vote time) + post-pass timelock.

patterns.name: Beanstalk Farms — flash-loan-governance-takeover
patterns.code_signature: Beanstalk on-chain governance had no execution timelock; attacker used flash-loaned liquidity to gain a supermajority and instantly pass a malicious proposal draining the protocol.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: governance-execution-timelock. Restore invariant: Governance proposals must not be executable within a single transaction/flash-loan window; voting power should not be flash-loanable into instant execution..

patterns.name: Wintermute (Profanity hot wallet) — weak-vanity-address-key-derivation
patterns.code_signature: Wintermute's hot wallet was a Profanity-generated vanity address; the tool's weak key generation let the private key be derived, and that address was still an authorized admin on the DeFi vault.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: secure-key-generation-and-revoke-admin. Restore invariant: Privileged keys must be generated with full entropy and revoked promptly when deprecated..

patterns.name: Vulcan Forged — custodial_private_key_compromise
patterns.code_signature: Private keys for 96 user custodial wallets (managed via the integrated Venly service) were compromised and the wallets drained.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: remove_custodial_keys_harden_custody. Restore invariant: User custodial private keys must remain confidential and non-extractable from the custody service..

patterns.name: Cream Finance Re-Pricing
patterns.code_signature: yUSD share price treated as price input to collateral; attacker doubled share value, drained collateral.
patterns.recommended_fix: Never treat unbounded share-price as a price feed; protect vault share-price with donation guards.

patterns.name: Cream Finance — share_price_oracle_manipulation
patterns.code_signature: PriceOracleProxy valued yUSDVault collateral by pricePerShare (balance/totalSupply); redeeming most supply then donating tokens roughly doubled per-share value, inflating collateral.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: manipulation_resistant_share_pricing. Restore invariant: Collateral share price must not be manipulable by changing vault totalSupply within a transaction..

patterns.name: Multichain MPC Key Compromise
patterns.code_signature: Cross-chain bridge custody concentrated in MPC keys held by a single individual; opaque off-chain key management.
patterns.recommended_fix: On-chain validator set with independent custody; rotate keys; publish proof-of-reserves.

patterns.name: BadgerDAO — frontend_compromise_approval_injection
patterns.code_signature: Attackers injected malicious token-approval transactions into Badger's compromised front-end, harvesting unlimited allowances and later draining user wallets directly.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: frontend_integrity_and_approval_scrutiny. Restore invariant: Front-end-served transaction calldata must match the intended user action; no unexpected approvals should be injected..

patterns.name: Mango Markets Oracle Manipulation
patterns.code_signature: On-chain perpetuals priced collateral via a thin spot oracle; attacker pumped the spot, borrowed, then dumped.
patterns.recommended_fix: Use TWAP or a multi-oracle median; circuit-breakers on rapid price moves; require minimum oracle liquidity depth.

patterns.name: Mango Markets — price-manipulation-collateral-inflation
patterns.code_signature: Attacker manipulated the thin MNGO spot/perp market to inflate the value of a large long position, then used the inflated unrealized PnL as collateral to borrow and drain all lending pools.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: robust-marking-and-collateral-limits. Restore invariant: Borrowing power must not be derived from unrealized PnL marked at an easily manipulable, illiquid price..

patterns.name: Harmony Horizon Bridge — multisig-key-compromise
patterns.code_signature: Harmony's Horizon bridge used a 2-of-5 multisig; two signer keys were compromised, giving full authority to drain the bridge.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: raise-multisig-threshold-secure-keys. Restore invariant: Bridge withdrawals must require a sufficiently high signer threshold so that compromise of a small number of keys cannot move funds..

patterns.name: HAWK (Hawk Tuah) — Rug / Pump-and-Dump
patterns.code_signature: Insiders and sniper bots controlled 80-90% of supply at TGE; coordinated dump within 20 minutes of peak drained retail liquidity.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: Launch Caps, Bonding Curves, Anti-Snipe Measures. Restore invariant: Token launches must enforce distribution invariants preventing majority insider/sniper capture at TGE..

patterns.name: Orbit Bridge — Key Compromise
patterns.code_signature: Unauthorized extraction of multisig private keys allowed attackers to drain bridge reserves.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: Decentralized Validator Networks; Threshold Signature Schemes. Restore invariant: Bridge vault assets must only be released upon cryptographic proof of corresponding lock/burn events on the origin chain..

patterns.name: Fei Protocol / Rari Capital (Fuse) — reentrancy
patterns.code_signature: Rari Fuse (Compound fork) CEther used call.value to send ETH before updating state; a malicious receiver re-entered exitMarket to withdraw collateral while keeping borrowed ETH.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: checks-effects-interactions-reentrancy-guard. Restore invariant: Borrow must record debt and finalize state before transferring ETH; a market cannot be exited while an unrecorded borrow is outstanding..

patterns.name: Qubit Finance (QBridge) — deposit-logic-flaw-mint-without-deposit
patterns.code_signature: Legacy deposit() left callable after depositETH() added; tokenAddress.safeTransferFrom did not revert on zero/null address, so attacker minted qXETH collateral on BSC without locking ETH on Ethereum.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: remove-dead-code-and-validate-transfer-amounts. Restore invariant: Minted bridge collateral on destination chain must be backed 1:1 by assets actually locked/transferred on the source chain..

patterns.name: Rari Fuse Reentrancy
patterns.code_signature: Compound-fork market allowed re-entrancy via ERC777 `_callTokensReceived` hook during borrow.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply reentrancy guards across the borrow/redeem path; reject ERC777 collateral or wrap.

patterns.name: Curve Vyper Reentrancy
patterns.code_signature: Vyper 0.2.15/0.2.16/0.3.0 mis-emitted `@nonreentrant` decorator; pools could re-enter via plain ETH receive.
patterns.recommended_fix: Upgrade Vyper compiler; audit any contract relying on @nonreentrant on the affected versions; prefer explicit Solidity-style mutex.

patterns.name: Munchables — Insider Threat / Planted Backdoor
patterns.code_signature: Rogue developer (suspected DPRK front) planted vulnerabilities prior to deployment and later exploited them.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: Mandatory Independent Audits and Multi-Party Code Review. Restore invariant: Protocol deployment must be preceded by independent third-party audits capable of detecting intentionally malicious execution paths, not only bugs..

patterns.name: EasyFi — admin_key_compromise
patterns.code_signature: Attacker compromised a machine and stole the single admin mnemonic; with no multisig or timelock, an unrestricted transfer function drained treasury liquidity and EASY tokens.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: multisig_and_timelock_for_admin. Restore invariant: Privileged treasury operations must require multisig/timelock and never be controllable by a single compromised key..

patterns.name: Uranium Finance — constant_product_invariant_error
patterns.code_signature: During v2 migration, the balance-check multiplier was changed from 1000 to 10000 in only some places, breaking the x*y=k check so 1 wei could swap for ~98% of reserves.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: review_constant_product_math_on_fork. Restore invariant: After every swap, reserve product k must not decrease (x*y=k must hold with consistent scaling constants)..

patterns.name: BtcTurk — Key Compromise
patterns.code_signature: Unauthorized access to hot wallet infrastructure enabled mass automated withdrawals across 10 cryptocurrencies on 7 chains.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: Strict Rate Limiting and Automated Anomaly Freezes. Restore invariant: Hot wallet transaction limits must prevent total depletion of operational liquidity by unauthorized actors..

patterns.name: KyberSwap Elastic Tick Rounding
patterns.code_signature: Concentrated-liquidity math rounded ticks such that a crafted swap moved across a boundary without paying the LP fee.
patterns.recommended_fix: Audit tick-cross math, add invariants on liquidity-delta application, integrate fuzzing on swap pathways.

patterns.name: Radiant Capital — Malware / Signer Bypass
patterns.code_signature: INLETDRIFT malware intercepted RPCs, substituting benign maintenance transactions with malicious contract upgrades while spoofing the developer UI.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: Independent Device Payload Decoding (e.g. Clear-Signing, Cosigner). Restore invariant: Hardware wallet signatures must strictly correspond to the payload intended and displayed by the host interface..

patterns.name: Radiant Capital LayerZero Drain
patterns.code_signature: Compromised multisig signers executed a malicious transaction through LayerZero proxy admin path.
patterns.recommended_fix: Hardware-key custody for all signers; simulation gating on every multisig tx; rotate signers after every breach signal.

patterns.name: Cashio — missing-account-validation-infinite-mint
patterns.code_signature: Cashio's collateral validation never checked the LP token's .mint field, letting an attacker pass worthless fake collateral accounts and mint unlimited CASH stablecoin.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: validate-all-account-constraints. Restore invariant: Minted CASH must be fully backed by validated, genuine collateral whose mint authority matches the expected token..

patterns.name: PancakeBunny — lp_price_manipulation_reward_mint
patterns.code_signature: VaultFlipToFlip valued LP/reward using PancakeSwap spot prices; flash loans skewed the WBNB-BUSDT pool so getReward minted ~6.97M BUNNY, which was dumped.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: use_manipulation_resistant_oracle. Restore invariant: Reward minting tied to LP value must use a manipulation-resistant price, not single-tx AMM spot reserves..

patterns.name: Alpha Homora (Iron Bank) — debt_share_rounding_manipulation
patterns.code_signature: Alpha Homora V2's empty sUSD pool plus a rounding flaw let totalDebt be inflated without increasing totalDebtShare, so the attacker borrowed huge sums treated as near-zero debt shares.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: fix_share_rounding_and_restrict_reserve_functions. Restore invariant: Debt shares must be monotonically consistent with totalDebt; borrowing must always increase a borrower's recorded debt share..

patterns.name: Vee Finance — amm_spot_price_oracle_manipulation
patterns.code_signature: Vee used a single-source Pangolin spot price without decimal processing, so price manipulation on a thin pair bypassed slippage checks during leveraged trades.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: use_manipulation_resistant_oracle. Restore invariant: Leveraged-trade pricing must use a manipulation-resistant oracle with correct decimal handling and enforce slippage bounds..

patterns.name: Harvest Finance Flashloan
patterns.code_signature: Yield strategy priced underlying via Curve spot during deposit/withdraw inside the same flash loan.
patterns.recommended_fix: Use TWAP, separate deposit/withdraw price snapshots, withdrawal fee buffer.

patterns.name: MonoX Finance — self_swap_price_inflation
patterns.code_signature: swapTokenForExactToken allowed the same token as tokenIn and tokenOut; swapping MONO against itself overwrote tokenIn price with the inflated tokenOut price.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: reject_self_swaps. Restore invariant: A swap must not use the same asset for input and output; price updates must not let a token inflate its own price..

patterns.name: Spartan Protocol — liquidity_share_balance_manipulation
patterns.code_signature: calcLiquidityShare() read current pool balance instead of a cached balance, so inflating the balance before burning LP tokens returned more assets than deposited.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: use_cached_internal_reserves. Restore invariant: LP redemption value must be computed from cached accounted reserves, not externally manipulable current token balances..

patterns.name: Grim Finance — reentrancy
patterns.code_signature: The vault's depositFor() lacked reentrancy protection and let users pass arbitrary deposit tokens, so a malicious token re-entered to loop fake deposits and inflate vault shares.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: reentrancy_guard_and_token_whitelist. Restore invariant: Vault share minting must complete state updates before external token-transfer callbacks; deposit tokens must be trusted..

patterns.name: Wintermute (Optimism OP) — create-opcode-address-replay
patterns.code_signature: Wintermute gave Optimism Foundation its mainnet Gnosis Safe address as the OP destination, but that address was uncontrolled on Optimism; because the original Safe used create (not create2), an attacker replayed deployments to claim the same address and seize 20M OP.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: verify-recipient-control-use-create2. Restore invariant: Funds must only be sent to addresses the recipient demonstrably controls on the target chain; counterfactual addresses must be non-replayable..

patterns.name: Penpie — Reentrancy
patterns.code_signature: batchHarvestMarketRewards lacked nonReentrant modifier, allowing malicious Pendle market to re-enter and inflate reward accounting.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: CEI Pattern; nonReentrant Locks on All State-Mutating Entry Points. Restore invariant: Reward accounting state must fully resolve before allowing external callbacks to alter vault balances..

patterns.name: FixedFloat — Key Compromise
patterns.code_signature: Attacker gained unauthorized access to operational private keys, draining exchange reserves.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: Hardware Security Modules (HSM). Restore invariant: Operational private keys must be inaccessible from external network interfaces..

patterns.name: Compound — Governance Voting Manipulation
patterns.code_signature: Attacker ('Humpy' / goldCOMP) accumulated delegated voting power and passed Proposal 289 transferring 499,000 COMP (~5% of treasury) to attacker-controlled multisig.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: Timelocks, Veto Powers, Quadratic/Conviction Voting. Restore invariant: Treasury execution must be resistant to delegated governance takeovers; large transfers require supermajority and delay..

patterns.name: Resolv — key compromise
patterns.code_signature: Attacker compromised contractor GitHub credentials, pivoted to AWS KMS, and exfiltrated SERVICE_ROLE private key used for protocol operations.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: hardware security modules; short-lived credentials; GitHub SSO + 2FA + audit logging; key rotation policies. Restore invariant: Critical operational keys (KMS SERVICE_ROLE etc.) must be protected by hardware-backed, multi-party, or least-privilege controls with no single contractor credential path..

patterns.name: Ankr / Helio Money — deployer-key-compromise-infinite-mint
patterns.code_signature: Ankr's BSC deployer key was compromised; the attacker upgraded the aBNBc token to a malicious implementation with an unrestricted mint function and minted ~60 trillion aBNBc, crashing the token and enabling downstream Helio borrowing.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: secure-key-custody-mint-access-control. Restore invariant: Token minting must enforce caller authorization; upgradeable implementations must be protected by secure key custody; collateral oracles must reflect crashed prices promptly..

patterns.name: Harvest Finance — amm_spot_price_oracle_manipulation
patterns.code_signature: Vault share price derived from Curve y-pool spot balances; flash loans temporarily skewed stablecoin prices so deposits/withdrawals minted/redeemed shares at distorted value.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: use_manipulation_resistant_oracle. Restore invariant: Vault share price must be immune to single-transaction manipulation of the underlying AMM spot price..

patterns.name: Elephant Money — price-oracle-manipulation
patterns.code_signature: TRUNK stablecoin minting swapped BUSD->WBNB->ELEPHANT during mint, inflating ELEPHANT spot price; attacker used flash loans to cycle this and extract value.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: manipulation-resistant-pricing-in-mint. Restore invariant: Stablecoin mint/redeem must not let a caller profit from price impact their own mint causes on the backing token..

patterns.name: Gala Games — Access Control
patterns.code_signature: Poor access controls on a privileged account allowed mint of 5B GALA tokens.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: Multisig Minter Roles and Timelocks. Restore invariant: Token supply expansion must require multi-signature governance resistant to single-account compromise..

patterns.name: Blizz Finance / Venus (Luna oracle) — stale-oracle-during-asset-collapse
patterns.code_signature: During the LUNA collapse, the Chainlink LUNA feed hit its minimum/froze while LUNA's real price crashed; Blizz/Venus kept valuing LUNA collateral at the stale price, letting attackers borrow against near-worthless LUNA.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: oracle-circuit-breakers-and-bounds. Restore invariant: Collateral valuation must track real market price and halt borrowing when the oracle is stale or pinned at its floor..

patterns.name: Sonne Finance — Precision Loss / Rounding
patterns.code_signature: EVM integer truncation allowed attacker to redeem underlying assets with fewer receipt tokens due to artificially inflated exchange rate in empty market.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: Minimum Liquidity Minting (Dead Shares). Restore invariant: Redeemed underlying tokens must strictly match proportionate value of burned receipt tokens without precision truncation loss..

patterns.name: Pickle Finance — missing_access_control
patterns.code_signature: ControllerV4's swapExactJarForJar did not whitelist jars, letting a fake malicious Jar be swapped against the legitimate cDAI jar to drain it.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: whitelist_trusted_contracts. Restore invariant: Inter-jar swaps must only operate on protocol-whitelisted, trusted jar contracts..

patterns.name: UwU Lend — oracle manipulation
patterns.code_signature: Price oracle for sUSDe manipulable via Curve; combined with aggressive rehypothecation and flash loan enabled cheap borrowing followed by liquidation or value extraction.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: oracle diversity and TWAP; borrow caps; reduced rehypothecation multipliers. Restore invariant: Oracle price used for borrowing/liquidation must reflect true market value without single-pool manipulation; collateral health must account for rehypothecation risk..

patterns.name: UwU Lend — Oracle Price Manipulation
patterns.code_signature: sUSDePriceProvider medianized 11 sources; 5 of them relied on Curve get_p spot price, so flash-loan induced intra-block manipulation pulled the median.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: TWAP Integration; Cross-Venue Sanity Checks. Restore invariant: Asset price valuation must remain resistant to intra-block flash-loan manipulation; medianizing spot sources is not sufficient..

patterns.name: Cream Finance — reentrancy
patterns.code_signature: Cream's lending market for AMP (an ERC777-style token) allowed a reentrant borrow during the token transfer callback, letting the attacker borrow twice against the same collateral.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: reentrancy_guard_and_token_review. Restore invariant: Borrow accounting must update before any external token-transfer callback (no reentrant borrow)..

patterns.name: bEarn Fi — vault_share_accounting_rounding
patterns.code_signature: BvaultsStrategy mishandled the difference between BUSD (18 decimals) and the underlying, letting an attacker exploit deposit/withdraw share accounting to drain vault funds.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: correct_decimal_and_share_math. Restore invariant: Vault share-to-asset conversion must be exact across differing token decimals and not allow net value extraction via deposit/withdraw..

patterns.name: Team Finance — migration-function-logic-flaw
patterns.code_signature: A flaw in Team Finance's Liquidity Locks migrate function (moving locked LP from Uniswap V2 to V3) let an attacker migrate to an attacker-controlled V3 pair at a skewed price and extract a large refund.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: validate-migration-destination-and-pricing. Restore invariant: Liquidity migration must preserve value and validate destination pool/price so no refund exceeds the migrated value..

patterns.name: Inverse Finance (Frontier) — price-oracle-manipulation
patterns.code_signature: Inverse's Keep3r-routed SushiSwap TWAP oracle for INV used a thin INV-WETH pair; attacker spiked the price and borrowed against overvalued INV collateral.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: robust-oracle-chainlink. Restore invariant: Collateral price must be resistant to single-block, single-pool manipulation before being used for borrowing limits..

patterns.name: Eminence Finance — bonding_curve_price_manipulation
patterns.code_signature: Unreleased EMN bonding-curve token contracts were discovered on-chain and manipulated via flash loans, minting/burning against the bonding curve to extract reserve DAI.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: do_not_deploy_funded_unreleased_contracts. Restore invariant: Bonding-curve reserve value must equal sum of outstanding token claims; partial burns across nested tokens must not let total redeemable value exceed reserves..

patterns.name: Deus Finance — price-oracle-manipulation
patterns.code_signature: Second Deus incident: lending price oracle again derived from a manipulable DEI liquidity pool, enabling flash-loan price distortion and improper borrowing/liquidations.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: twap-or-decentralized-oracle. Restore invariant: Collateral pricing must use a manipulation-resistant oracle independent of instantly-flash-loanable pool spot prices..

patterns.name: SwapNet — Arbitrary External Call
patterns.code_signature: SwapNet Router's swap function (0x87395540) performed a low-level call to a user-supplied target with user-controlled calldata; attacker set target to USDC and calldata to transferFrom to drain approvals.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: Strict Call-Target Whitelist + Function-Selector Validation + Per-Tx Approval Patterns. Restore invariant: Aggregator low-level calls must validate target address against a whitelist of known DEX routers; arbitrary user-supplied targets must be rejected..

patterns.name: Polter Finance — Oracle Price Manipulation
patterns.code_signature: Hardcoded roundId=2 in ChainlinkUniV2Adapter prevented historical TWAP check, forcing reliance on manipulated spot price.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: Dynamic Oracle Round Parameterization; Reject Oracles with Hardcoded Rounds. Restore invariant: Oracle price feeds must dynamically fetch historical data to validate spot-price integrity against extreme variance..

patterns.name: Li.Fi — Call Injection
patterns.code_signature: depositToGasZipERC20 accepted user-provided swapData without validation, executing arbitrary transferFrom against user approvals.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: Strict Calldata Whitelisting and Target Address Verification. Restore invariant: User-provided calldata must not execute unauthorized state changes or token transfers on behalf of the contract..

patterns.name: Saddle Finance — amm-metapool-accounting-flaw
patterns.code_signature: A flaw in Saddle's metapool swap accounting allowed an attacker to extract value by swapping through the pool at mispriced rates.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: correct-amm-invariant-math. Restore invariant: AMM swap accounting must preserve the pool invariant so no swap path returns more value than fairly priced..

patterns.name: Cover Protocol — infinite_mint
patterns.code_signature: Blacksmith staking contract had a storage/memory bug; leaving 1 wei of LP balance and re-depositing triggered massively inflated COVER reward minting.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: fix_storage_aliasing_and_bound_minting. Restore invariant: Reward minting must be bounded by actual stake and elapsed time; storage and memory copies of accounting structs must not diverge..

patterns.name: Crema Finance — missing-account-owner-validation
patterns.code_signature: Crema's fee-claim path failed to validate the owner of the tick account storing price/fee data; attacker supplied a fake tick account with fabricated fee data and claimed inflated fees.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: validate-account-ownership. Restore invariant: Accounts supplying fee/price data must be validated as protocol-owned before being trusted for payouts..

patterns.name: Moola Market — price-oracle-manipulation
patterns.code_signature: Moola (Aave fork on Celo) priced its low-liquidity MOO token via a manipulable feed; attacker pumped MOO and borrowed against the inflated collateral.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: manipulation-resistant-oracle. Restore invariant: Collateral for a low-liquidity governance token must use a manipulation-resistant price..

patterns.name: Visor Finance — missing_access_control
patterns.code_signature: The vVISR/Visor supply deposit function failed to verify the caller against the recorded owner, letting the attacker mint reward shares and drain VISR.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: validate_caller_ownership. Restore invariant: Deposit/mint must verify msg.sender matches the position owner before crediting shares..

patterns.name: Slope Wallet (Solana wallet drain) — seed-phrase-exposure-via-logging
patterns.code_signature: The Slope mobile wallet transmitted users' seed phrases in plaintext to a centralized logging/telemetry server; an attacker who accessed those logs drained the affected wallets.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: never-log-secrets-client-side-only-keys. Restore invariant: A non-custodial wallet must never transmit or store user seed phrases/private keys off-device in recoverable form..

patterns.name: THORChain — deposit_event_spoofing
patterns.code_signature: A fake router/Asgard contract and malformed memo made Bifrost misread a forwarded ETH transfer as a legitimate deposit, triggering an erroneous refund to the attacker.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: strict_source_and_memo_validation. Restore invariant: Bifrost must only credit deposits from genuine vault flows and validate memo/source authenticity before refunding..

patterns.name: Anyswap — ecdsa_nonce_reuse
patterns.code_signature: The V3 Router's MPC signing reused the same ECDSA k (nonce) across two BSC transactions, allowing the private key to be back-calculated and bridge liquidity drained.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: deterministic_or_unique_nonce_rfc6979. Restore invariant: Every ECDSA signature must use a unique random nonce k; nonce reuse must never occur..

patterns.name: Warp Finance — lp_token_price_oracle_manipulation
patterns.code_signature: Uniswap WETH-DAI LP token used as collateral was valued via the manipulable AMM spot price; flash loans inflated LP value to over-borrow.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: fair_lp_pricing_oracle. Restore invariant: LP collateral valuation must reflect manipulation-resistant fair price, not instantaneous reserves..

patterns.name: Meter.io Passport Bridge — deposit-logic-flaw-mint-without-lock
patterns.code_signature: Meter's fork of ChainSafe ChainBridge modified the ERC20 handler deposit logic for wrapped native tokens; the unguarded deposit() trusted an arbitrary amount in calldata without an actual token transfer, allowing minting of BNB/wETH.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: validate-locked-amount-and-guard-deposit. Restore invariant: Bridge-minted wrapped native tokens must equal the native tokens actually locked in the handler contract..

patterns.name: BurgerSwap — missing_constant_product_check
patterns.code_signature: Uniswap-fork pair omitted the x*y=k check and allowed reentrancy, letting a fake token pair be used to swap for large output while paying ~1 unit input.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: restore_invariant_check_and_reentrancy_guard. Restore invariant: Every swap must preserve the constant product k and complete reserve updates before any reentrant call..

patterns.name: Origin Dollar (OUSD) — reentrancy
patterns.code_signature: OUSD mint function performed token transfer-in before updating supply/rebase accounting, allowing a reentrant malicious token to mint OUSD without backing.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: checks_effects_interactions_and_reentrancy_guard. Restore invariant: Total OUSD supply must always be fully backed; mint accounting must complete before any external call..

patterns.name: Value DeFi — amm_spot_price_oracle_manipulation
patterns.code_signature: Vault used Curve spot price as oracle and used the wrong Curve math function on withdrawal; flash-loan manipulation let attacker withdraw excess via the Vault/Proxy path.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: use_manipulation_resistant_oracle. Restore invariant: Collateral/share valuation must not rely on a manipulable AMM spot price reachable within one transaction..

patterns.name: Lodestar Finance — price-oracle-manipulation
patterns.code_signature: Lodestar's GLPOracle priced plvGLP without accounting for donate() to the GlpDepositor; an attacker donated to inflate the contract's assets and thus the plvGLP price, then borrowed against inflated collateral.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: manipulation-resistant-oracle-accounting. Restore invariant: Collateral price for plvGLP must not be inflatable by direct donations to the underlying depositor..

patterns.name: Abracadabra — Precision / Accounting Flaw
patterns.code_signature: CauldronV4 repayForAll reduced totalBorrowAssets without proportionally reducing totalBorrowShares, enabling share inflation via 1-wei rounding loops.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: Proportional Share Accounting and Rounding Checks. Restore invariant: A reduction in total borrow assets must yield an exactly proportional reduction in total borrow shares..

patterns.name: Abracadabra Finance — precision error
patterns.code_signature: Loss of precision during smart contract arithmetic in Cauldrons V3/V4 allowed unauthorized MIM borrowing.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: use of safe math libraries with explicit precision handling; versioned contract audits. Restore invariant: Borrowed MIM amount must never exceed collateral value after all precision/rounding operations in the cauldron accounting..

patterns.name: Belt Finance — multi_strategy_share_valuation_flaw
patterns.code_signature: Belt valued multi-strategy vault shares assuming all strategies stay balanced; flash loans unbalanced the Venus/Ellipsis strategies to over-redeem on withdrawal.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: robust_multi_strategy_valuation. Restore invariant: Vault share valuation must be correct under arbitrary strategy imbalance, not assume balanced pools..

patterns.name: Hundred Finance — reentrancy
patterns.code_signature: Hundred Finance (Compound fork) on Gnosis Chain hit by the same callback reentrancy via xDai token _callAfterTransfer, allowing over-borrowing before debt updates.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: reentrancy-guard-and-token-vetting. Restore invariant: Outstanding debt must be recorded before control returns to the caller or additional borrowing occurs..

patterns.name: Audius — proxy-storage-collision-reinitialization
patterns.code_signature: Audius governance proxy stored its admin in slot 0, colliding with OpenZeppelin Initializable, letting the attacker re-initialize governance, fake voting power, and pass a treasury-draining proposal.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: fix-storage-layout-disable-reinit. Restore invariant: A deployed proxy's initializer must not be re-callable; admin storage must not collide with logic storage..

patterns.name: Defrost Finance — fake-collateral-oracle-manipulation
patterns.code_signature: Defrost's V1 was drained when a fake collateral token with a manipulated price oracle was added (via owner privileges), triggering improper liquidations; widely flagged as a rug-pull-style backdoor.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: restrict-privileged-parameter-changes. Restore invariant: New collateral tokens and price oracles must not be addable by a single privileged key without controls; liquidation prices must come from trusted feeds..

patterns.name: Inverse Finance — price-oracle-manipulation
patterns.code_signature: Second Inverse incident: attacker manipulated the price of a collateral token (yvCurve/CRV-based) feeding the oracle to borrow DOLA against inflated collateral.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: manipulation-resistant-oracle. Restore invariant: Collateral pricing must be resistant to flash-loan manipulation of the underlying liquidity pool..

patterns.name: Agave DAO — reentrancy
patterns.code_signature: Agave (Aave fork) on Gnosis Chain accepted a token whose _callAfterTransfer hook enabled reentrancy; attacker re-entered borrow before debt was recorded.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: reentrancy-guard-and-token-vetting. Restore invariant: A borrower's outstanding debt must be fully recorded before control returns to the borrower or further borrowing is allowed..

patterns.name: Radiant Capital — precision error
patterns.code_signature: Flaw in token quantity calculation logic allowed precision expansion and rounding errors to let attacker borrow or drain more than collateral justified.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: input sanitization and precise arithmetic libraries; bounded flash-loan impact. Restore invariant: Token quantity and accounting calculations must conserve value exactly without exploitable rounding or precision expansion allowing excess borrow or drain..

patterns.name: ChainSwap — broken_signature_authorization
patterns.code_signature: The per-token proxy Factory's mint authorization could be bypassed by supplying a fresh address as the signature, letting the attacker mint bridged tokens to arbitrary addresses.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: verify_signer_against_message. Restore invariant: Cross-chain mints must require a valid signature from the authorized signer over the specific mint payload..

patterns.name: Raydium — admin-key-compromise
patterns.code_signature: Raydium's pool-owner/admin private key was compromised (suspected trojan), letting the attacker drain accumulated pool fees and inflate withdrawals via the withdraw_pnl path.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: secure-admin-key-and-bound-withdrawals. Restore invariant: Privileged pool-owner authority must be securely custodied; fee withdrawals must be bounded by genuine accrued fees..

patterns.name: Aperture Finance — Arbitrary External Call
patterns.code_signature: Function 0x67b34120 invoked internal 0x1d33 executing low-level calls with user-supplied calldata without enforcing strict target/selector constraints; enabled ERC-20 drainage and Uniswap V3 NFT approvals.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: Call-Target + Selector Whitelist; Periodic NFT Approval Revocation. Restore invariant: Aggregator low-level calls must validate target address and function selector; NFT approvals must not be reachable via arbitrary calldata paths..

patterns.name: Aperture Finance — arbitrary call
patterns.code_signature: V3/V4 contracts had arbitrary-call vulnerability from insufficient input validation, enabling abuse of existing ERC20/NFT approvals to drain via transferFrom.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: strict calldata validation and function whitelisting; scoped approvals; immediate pause on anomaly. Restore invariant: Approved tokens and NFTs held or managed by the protocol can only be moved via intended protocol functions; arbitrary calls cannot trigger unauthorized transferFrom..

patterns.name: Nirvana Finance — price-manipulation-flash-loan
patterns.code_signature: Attacker flash-loaned $10M from Solend to mint ANA and inflate its price on the bonding curve, then redeemed overvalued ANA against Nirvana's treasury.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: manipulation-resistant-redemption-pricing. Restore invariant: Treasury redemption price for ANA must not be inflatable within a single flash-loan transaction..

patterns.name: Socket Tech — Call Injection
patterns.code_signature: SocketGateway accepted external swapExtraData; attacker triggered transferFrom exploiting approvals. Zero-native-balance-delta bypassed the sanity check.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: Comprehensive Post-Call Invariant Checks. Restore invariant: Post-execution balance checks must cover all token types reachable via arbitrary calldata, not only native amounts..

patterns.name: Skyward Finance — treasury-accounting-flaw
patterns.code_signature: A flaw in Skyward's treasury/redemption accounting on NEAR let an attacker redeem SKYWARD against the treasury for more than its backing.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: correct-treasury-accounting. Restore invariant: Token redemptions against the treasury must not pay out more than the redeemed tokens' backing..

patterns.name: Deus Finance — price-oracle-manipulation
patterns.code_signature: Deus lending used the manipulable Solidex/SpiritSwap sAMM USDC/DEI pool as collateral price oracle; attacker flash-loaned DEI to distort it and force liquidations.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: twap-or-decentralized-oracle. Restore invariant: Collateral valuation for liquidations must use a manipulation-resistant price, not an instantaneous single-pool spot price..

patterns.name: Fortress Protocol — oracle-and-governance-manipulation
patterns.code_signature: Fortress (Compound fork) combined a manipulable oracle with cheap governance, letting the attacker push a fake collateral price and borrow against it.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: robust-oracle-and-governance-safeguards. Restore invariant: Collateral price and governance-controlled parameters must not be cheaply manipulable to inflate borrowing power..

patterns.name: TempleDAO (STAX) — missing-access-control
patterns.code_signature: TempleDAO's StaxLPStaking migrateStake function lacked validation of the caller-supplied staking contract, letting an attacker pass a malicious contract to withdraw staked LP tokens.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: validate-trusted-contracts-access-control. Restore invariant: Migration functions must validate that the supplied external contract is a trusted/whitelisted address before moving user funds..

patterns.name: Akropolis — reentrancy
patterns.code_signature: Deposit credited the user based on before/after balance difference; a malicious token re-entered deposit during transfer, getting double-credited.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: reentrancy_guard_and_token_whitelist. Restore invariant: Deposit accounting must not double-count value when the token transfer can re-enter the deposit function..

patterns.name: Pike Finance — Storage Layout Misalignment
patterns.code_signature: Upgrade shifted storage layout, causing `initialized` variable to read as false; allowed attacker to re-initialize and hijack contract.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: Storage Layout Verification (storage-gap pattern, upgrade simulators). Restore invariant: Storage slot variables must remain strictly aligned and immutable across proxy upgrades..

patterns.name: Bedrock (uniBTC) — Math / Scaling
patterns.code_signature: mint() accepted native ETH without applying ETH/BTC exchange rate, minting uniBTC 1:1 with deposited ETH.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: Oracle Price Feed Integration for All Collateral Types. Restore invariant: Fiat value of deposited collateral must strictly equal or exceed fiat value of synthetic tokens minted..

patterns.name: BonqDAO — oracle-manipulation
patterns.code_signature: BonqDAO trusted Tellor spot price values for WALBT collateral; an attacker who staked only 10 TRB gained price-reporting rights and submitted an arbitrary price.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: use-twap-or-multi-oracle-with-staleness-and-deviation-checks. Restore invariant: Collateral valuation must use a manipulation-resistant (time-averaged / multi-source) price, not a single attacker-controllable spot report..

patterns.name: Nexera — Key Compromise
patterns.code_signature: Fake-job-offer malware extracted the private key controlling the proxy admin, enabling withdrawAdmin execution.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: Multisig Ownership and Timelocks. Restore invariant: Proxy contract ownership must require multi-signature consensus resistant to single-endpoint malware infection..

patterns.name: bZx Flash Loan
patterns.code_signature: Lending market accepted a Uniswap V1 spot reading as oracle inside an atomic borrow; flash loan pushed price atomically.
patterns.recommended_fix: Block oracle reads within the same atomic context as a price-impacting trade; use TWAP.

patterns.name: Silo Finance — oracle misconfiguration
patterns.code_signature: Misconfigured or stale oracle parameters allowed incorrect price feeds leading to improper liquidations or value extraction.
patterns.recommended_fix: Apply mitigation class: oracle health checks; automated circuit breakers; conservative config defaults. Restore invariant: Oracle prices used for borrowing, collateral valuation, and liquidation must be fresh, correctly sourced, and match intended market parameters at all times..
